The Markdown preview pane can now open the document full-window in your default browser.

- Press `o` (or click `o: browser`) in the preview pane header to open the document in your browser. The side pane can't grow past 45% of the terminal, so this is the way to read a long document at full width
- The page uses the same Markdown parser as the pane: tables, alert boxes and front matter look the same, relative images and links resolve against the document's folder, and the whole document is shown (the pane stops at 90,000 characters)
- Mermaid diagrams render when you're online (the browser loads mermaid from cdn.jsdelivr.net); the document itself is not sent anywhere
- The page is written to `/tmp/claude-<uid>/desk-look/<name>.html` and opened with `xdg-open` (`open` on macOS), with no shell

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
